protocol-narration-plan.text: One typed event stream, threaded as an argument from the entry point, with every output a renderer of it. Base: main 2cafe6b2.

strategy.text: Contra-tracer with typed events, built with contra-tracer-contrib, which is already pinned. The phase log module and its environment reads are deleted in the same change. Missing combinators, such as a socket sink, go to contra-tracer-contrib by pull request. No model rule, transaction, receipt field or exit code changes.

module-rows.text: Provider-level events live in local services. The library builders, the Koios runtime and the node services take a tracer argument. The write session owns transaction events, the command handlers own registry, request and edge events, and a CLI trace module owns the controls, the sinks and the three renderers. The Demo 1 journey and the node guide are updated.

data-rows.text: Trace level, trace sink, protocol scope from registry down to transaction, step events with elapsed time, and four disjoint refusal kinds.

function-rows.text: Command handlers and the session functions gain a tracer argument; the functions that read the environment take a tracer instead; the text and phase-log renderers are pure functions.

slices.text: Narration first, tasks one to five, merged before the Demo 1 review on 8 October. Then the socket sink, task six.

live-boundary.text: No preprod writes and no new registry. The operator makes the Demo 1 recording.
